documents.name: ETA Application Form
documents.notes: Fill out the official online ETA application form. Use our Form Fill Helper below for step-by-step guidance.

documents.name: Passport Bio Page Scan
documents.notes: Upload a clear, full scan of your passport's bio-data page in JPG/JPEG format.
requirements: Must show the full page including MRZ code at the bottom.
Passport must be valid for at least 6 months from arrival date with at least 3 blank pages.

documents.name: Confirmed Return Ticket
documents.notes: Prepare a confirmed return ticket or onward journey ticket.
requirements: Must be a confirmed return or onward ticket to another destination.

documents.name: Proof of Sufficient Funds
documents.notes: Prepare proof of sufficient funds to meet the expenses during the stay (this might be needed at the port of entry).
requirements: Can include cash, credit card statements, or traveler's cheques to cover expenses during the stay.

importantNotes: Government fee is waived (0 USD) for 30 days for tourist visa.
The ETA is initially limited up to 30 days from the date of arrival and it can be extended up to six months (see: https://www.immigrationlanka.com/Info-2-15.html?locale=en_US).
Make sure all details match your passport exactly. Incorrect details will lead to boarding rejection or entry denial.
A Yellow Fever vaccination certificate is required if you are arriving from a Yellow Fever infected area.
